node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 exact distinct-slope budget ledger
node.statement: Conditional on the complete positive-coordinate payment, the exhaustive orientation/source-cover assembly, and the exact active-allocation inequality, the KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 arm has the disjoint distinct-affine-slope ledger U_K3=U_positive+U_sourcecover within its active allocation. The proved c2(1,1,2) source-line and negative-coordinate exclusions contribute zero as evidence. Every nonzero one-pencil payment has genuine-pencil hypotheses and exact relevant-line multiplicity; every higher-dimensional survivor has an exact ray compiler. No unnamed multiplicity, owner change, or separately normalized budget is allowed.
node.falsifier: A missing or overlapping slope owner, incorrect route integer, non-genuine pencil payment, uncounted line, unpaid higher-dimensional survivor, or U_K3 above the active allocation.
